sentence: This project tries to pull changing traits of genetic conditions out of health records so that genetic results can be reinterpreted in clinical practice.
This project turns a genetically engineered mouse model of a cancer into a dre-rox based model to study mechanisms and test therapeutic targets.
This project studies when during development dietary manganese and a gene play a role in keeping the intestine healthy in bowel disease.
This project studies how air pollution and neighborhood deprivation affect the development and progression of lung cancer in people with non-small cell lung cancer.
This project builds artificial intelligence tools to learn which molecular and tissue features separate clinical outcomes in patients with prostate cancer who undergo surgery.
This project studies how disease-causing mutations and drugs change the way mTOR proteins interact inside neurons.
This project sequences genomes of diverse populations in Oceania to reconstruct the evolutionary past of humans and find the genetic basis of disease susceptibility.
This project provides microscopes and cell sorting equipment for imaging and cell sorting experiments in research.
This project builds a diagnostic platform that uses a microchip and CRISPR technology to detect HIV viral load and drug resistance in one visit.
This project studies how transcriptional and metabolic pathways shape the differentiation and heterogeneity of T cells and their antitumor immunity.
This project tests strategies in early phase clinical trials to prevent cancer by targeting specific cancer causes.
This project studies how ovarian cancer cells adapt during metastasis, focusing on a class of proteins activated when cells detach from the matrix.
This project studies the signaling pathways that control development and stem cell production in plants.
This project uses spatial metabolomics to describe the metabolic features of individual microglia in tissue sections in Alzheimer's disease.
This project offers genomics and bioinformatics services, including sequencing analysis and genome editing studies, to support research.
This project tries to find out where a subset of regulatory T cells goes and what it does to restore lung function after flu infections.
This project tests ways to study the genomes of single human cells, where mutations differ from cell to cell, a phenomenon called somatic mosaicism.
This project studies how T cells and B cells recognize glycans, and how this recognition may help protect mice against Staphylococcus aureus.
This project tests veterinary samples to find contamination of animal food and tissues early, to help prevent disease in humans.
